**Luogo:** Roma

Stage iniziale di 6 mesi con possibilità di rinnovo di altri 6 mesi. La possibilità di attivare anche uno stage curricolare costituisce un elemento preferenziale.
  
  

Il paziente è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo, motivo per cui i nostri team si concentrano sulla ricerca di soluzioni e trattamenti per alcune delle malattie più difficili del mondo. Il candidato verrà inserito nel nostro dipartimento a supporto dell’attività lavorativa.

* Comprendere il contesto di riferimento, evidenziando opportunità e barriere.
* Rafforzare il posizionamento, sulla base del profilo clinico e di accesso della molecola.
* Analizzare il mercato per definire il potenziale e monitorare i competitor, a supporto delle ipotesi nelle attuali fasi di stage gate.
* In collaborazione con Medical Affairs, comprendere il profilo dei pazienti al fine di creare una strategia target e segmentare la popolazione.

* Laurea in ambito scientifico o economico.
* Capacità di analisi dei dati e conoscenza dei principali tools
* Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel e Power Point
* Capacità di lavorare in sinergia con gli altri
* Conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata.

Facendo il tuo tirocinio presso la nostra azienda avrai lopportunità di crescere allinterno di una delle aziende farmaceutiche leader a livello mondiale.
  
  

* Avrai un‘esperienza pratica allinterno dellindustria farmaceutica
* Lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico
* Sviluppare capacità analitiche e di problem solving


Pari opportunità
  
  

Siamo orgogliosi di essere unazienda che riunisce persone diverse, di talento e impegnate. Il modo più veloce per innovare è unire idee diverse in un ambiente inclusivo. Creiamo un ambiente in cui i nostri dipendenti possono sfidare rispettosamente il pensiero degli altri e affrontare i problemi collettivamente. Garantiamo pari opportunità, con limpegno a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo.

**Catalent is a global leader in clinical supply services, working with clinical trial sponsors of all sizes to reliably supply their clinical trials. With 9 GMP facilities in the US, EU, and Asia/Pacific region, and more than 50 depots covering 6 continents, our Clinical \& Specialty Services (CSS) segment delivers flexible, integrated solutions to accelerate product development and ensure reliable global supply chain execution**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Position Summary**
--------------------


We have an opportunity for a Contracts Manager for Clinical Supply Services to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with Business Development, Site Operations, and Legal teams across EMEA and APAC. You will lead negotiations and manage the execution of customer contracts, ensuring compliance with company standards and supporting business growth. This position is key to maintaining strong customer relationships and driving operational excellence.

**Location: Aprilia, Italy**  

**100% Onsite**

**The Role**
------------

* Serve as a strategic partner to Business Development, Site Operations, and Legal teams across EMEA and APAC.
* Lead the negotiation and execution of customer contracts, ensuring alignment with commercial goals and legal standards.
* Negotiate customer contracts in partnership with Business Development, Legal, and other functional leads to achieve timely deal closure and support business growth.
* Act as the lead on negotiations with customers on commercial contracting terms.
* Assess and mitigate contractual risks, recommending language that supports business objectives.
* Ensure contracts reflect company priorities and comply with legal and organizational policies and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records and tracking of contract status and progress.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to enhancing customer experience.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel as needed.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience negotiating contracts with senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of commercial contract terms in both Europe and the US.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with a customer\-focused mindset.
* Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing.
* Fluency in English

### **Preferred Skills \& Background**

* Experience negotiating the commercial aspects of contracts.
* Solid understanding of payment terms, liability, and insurance clauses.
* Pharmaceutical industry experience is a plus, but not essential.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience working directly with customers and managing contract\-related discussions.
* Understanding of the customer onboarding process and how it relates to contractual obligations.

Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

* Qualified female applicants, qualified nationals of non\-and under\-represented Members and person with disabilities are encouraged to apply;
* Everyone who works for FAO is required to adhere to the highest standards of integrity and professional conduct, and to uphold FAO's values
* FAO, as a Specialized Agency of the United Nations, has a zero\-tolerance policy for conduct that is incompatible with its status, objectives and mandate, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination
* All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks
* All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality

*FAO’s commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.*  

  

**Organizational Setting**  



  

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is committed to fostering an organizational culture of ethics and a harmonious and inclusive work environment, anchored in the values of integrity, accountability, transparency, mutual respect and professionalism. The Ethics Office is integral to this effort, and it has an overall mandate to act as an independent organ. The office is working under the leadership of the Senior Ethics Officer who reports directly to the Director\-General.


This Call for expression of interest (EOI) is issued to build a pool of suitable candidates from junior to senior level, who can undertake a range of different tasks as and when required depending on the specific needs of the Ethics Office. The technical focus of the specific assignment may therefore not comprehend all the areas mentioned above.

  

**Reporting Lines**

  

  

The incumbent will work under the direct supervision of the Ethics Officer.  



**Technical Focus**

  

  

Substantial support to all the areas of the Ethics Office’s mandate, specifically:
  

Policy development, Prima facie reviews of retaliation complaints, Training and outreach activities.  



**Tasks and responsibilities**

  

  

In close collaboration with the Ethics Office personnel, the incumbent will:
  

• Support formulation of FAO\-wide policies and procedures on Ethics matters in alignment with FAO’s organizational strategy, the practical realities of operating in the field, UN Reform, FAO’s work environment, and the public environment with the safety and dignity of those we serve at the core of all the work.
  

• Review, advise and support standard setting and policy support activities of other departments including country and regional offices, helping to ensure that the corporate policies are adequately implemented on the ground.
  

• Review individual cases and provide advice and guidance on issues related to the Ethics office mandate and in particular on conflicts of interest and protection from retaliation.
  

• Provide advice, conduct preliminary assessments, and propose appropriate recommendations for complaints of Retaliation
  

• Monitor current developments and best practices in organizational ethics and proactively suggest improvements to internal policies, SOPs and practices.
  

• Develop internal and public outreach material in all key policy and functional areas of the Ethics Office to create awareness and mainstream ethical principles across the Organization, facilitating also accountability towards external stakeholders.
  

• Support the development of ethics training materials and programmes.
  

• Support the development of project documents, administrative reports, power point presentations and webinars, to staff and senior management.
  

• Any other task related to carrying out successfully the Ethics Office mandate.  



  

**CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**  



**Minimum Requirements**

  

  

• Advanced university degree from an institution recognized by the International Association of Universities (IAU)/UNESCO in political science, law, public administration, communication or other relevant areas. Consultants with bachelor's degree need two additional years of relevant professional experience.
  

• At least 1 (one) year of experience for category C and at least 5 (five) years of relevant experience for category B with focus on ethics, compliance, UN administrative law, policy drafting and development, risk assessment and management, etc.
  

• Working knowledge of English (level C).  



**FAO Core Competencies**

  

  

• Results Focus
  

• Teamwork
  

• Communication
  

• Building Effective Relationships
  

• Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement  



**Technical/Functional Skills**

  

  

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with ability to collect, collate and analyze data in an efficient manner;
  

• Strong demonstrated written skills with emphasis in legal policy drafting, report writing and editing
  

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, e.g. to provide advice and guidance, give presentations, and to network, consult and build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  

• Advanced knowledge and understanding of theories, concepts and approaches relevant to UN administrative law and the Standards of Conduct of the International Civil Service.
  

• Extent and relevance of experience in supporting or leading protection against retaliation assessments.
  

• Experience from a UN/Multilateral organization;
  

• High standards of ethics and ethical conduct, impeccable integrity, and respect for confidentiality;
  

• Proven ability to produce outputs independently with minimal supervision or guidance, while at the same time seeking innovative ways to mainstream Ethics across the Organization.  



**Selection criteria**

  

  

• Relevant ethics experience within an international organization is considered an asset.
  

• Working knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desired, and knowledge of Arabic, Chinese, or Russian is considered as an asset

  

Please note that all candidates should adhere to FAO Values of Commitment to FAO, Respect for All and Integrity and Transparency
